classification.difficultyReason: Name individual angles with the vertex letter in the middle.

content.prompt: Name each angle below, using three letters (for example, $\angle AOB$).

spec.description: Two segments meeting at B, with no angle arc; source blue rendered black.
spec.mathematics: BA rises right and BC is horizontal right.

answer.worked: The vertex is $B$, so it is the middle letter: $\angle ABC$ or $\angle CBA$.

spec.description: Two segments meeting at L, with no angle arc; source blue rendered black.
spec.mathematics: LK rises steeply left and LM slopes slightly down right.

answer.worked: The vertex is $L$, so it is the middle letter: $\angle KLM$ or $\angle MLK$.

spec.description: Two segments meeting at V, with no angle arc; source blue rendered black.
spec.mathematics: VX slopes down left and VZ slopes slightly down right.

answer.worked: The vertex is $V$, so it is the middle letter: $\angle XVZ$ or $\angle ZVX$.
